data.title: Vehicle tax assessment (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for MS-JB 2604
data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen assessed annual vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) of €146.00 for vehicle MS-JB 2604, effective from its registration on 2 November 2026, to be collected automatically by direct debit.
data.explanation: This is an official tax assessment from the German customs office responsible for car tax (Hauptzollamt). It fixes your annual vehicle tax at €146.00 for vehicle MS-JB 2604, starting from its registration date, and will be debited automatically from your account each year. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Hauptzollamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and the tax keeps being collected automatically every year.

remedy.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen erheben.

items.action: If you disagree with the assessed amount, submit a written objection (Einspruch) to the Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the tax assessment becomes final and binding.

items.title: Pay the annual vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer)
items.action: No action needed; the €146.00 annual vehicle tax will be debited automatically from the account on file each year.
